note: Schemas of feature 106 that the sync script of feature 100 delivers into packages/contracts/schemas/ (the mechanism of T299 of feature 100). Keys are the target names in the package; values are paths relative to this directory. Every target ends in `-106`, so the sync keeps it and none takes the name of a file of feature 100 or of another feature. These four are the records of annex B §B.20 (the retrospective was added by T068); the records that are not there (the advice rows, the mode selector result) stay internal to the package, in packages/learning/schemas/, with an internal $id (row 32 of 'What the other features must follow').
